senses.gloss: वेग- + वाहिन् वेग- + वाहिन्, adj. swift, Rājat. 5, 217.

वेग वेग, i. e. विज् + अ, m.
 1. Speed, Vikr. 6, 6; Pañc. ii. d. 174; 258, 21 [] (वेगाद् वेगं गम्, To increase one's speed more and more).
 2. The flight of an arrow, Kir. 13, 24.
 3. Impetus, Bhāg. P. 5, 7, 11; breeze, Mālat. 127, 12.
 4. Stream, Hit. iv. d. 59.
 5. Sudden impulse, inconsiderate haste, Pañc. i. d. 122.
 6. Energy.
 7. Strength, Rām. 5, 3, 42.
 8. Pleasure.
 9. Love.
 10. External indication of any internal effect, proceeding from passion, medicine, poison, etc., as convulsion, sweat, etc., Daśak. in Chr. 187, 16.
 11. Evacuation of natural excretions.
 12. Semen virile.
 --Comp.

वेगवन्त् वेग + वन्त्, adj., f. वती,
 1. Swift, Rām. 3, 50, 5.
 2. Impetuous, Lass. 2. ed. 79, 77; 78.

वेगित वेगित, i. e. वेग + इत, adj.
 1. Quickened.
 2. Swift, MBh. 8, 3048.
वेगिता वेगिता, i. e. वेगिन् + ता, f. Speed.

वेगिन् वेगिन्, i. e. वेग + इन्,
 I. adj. Swift, Kir. 8, 39.
 II. m.
 1. A courier.
 2. A hawk.
 III. f. नी, A river, Rām. 2, 55, 6, ed. Seramp.
